registration.intro: Yoties Flag Football is a program of She Makes Plays Foundation of AZ, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit. We field competitive girls flag football teams in North Phoenix.

bullets.label: Divisions:
bullets.text: 10U and 12U girls. No flag football experience required — if she loves to run and compete, we'll teach her the rest.

bullets.label: Where we play:
bullets.text: Brigade Football League plus local tournaments. Practices in the Desert Ridge / North Scottsdale / Cave Creek area.

bullets.label: Official affiliate:
bullets.text: we are an official NFL FLAG affiliate team.

bullets.label: Dues:
bullets.text: CONFIRM WITH COACH JOSH BEFORE LAUNCH — placeholder pending real fee schedule.

bullets.label: Ways to pay:
bullets.text: monthly invoice by text or email.

bullets.label: Questions:
bullets.text: reach us at info@shemakesplays.org or DM @yotiesfootball on Instagram.
